description: AGENTS.md states the pre-commit hook is run by 'husky', a Node.js-based git-hook manager. However, there is no root-level package.json in the repository (by design, since the Leptos migration removed all root JS/Node tooling), and husky is not installed. The actual pre-commit hook is a plain bash script at .githooks/pre-commit, installed manually via `git config core.hooksPath .githooks` or `scripts/install-git-hooks.sh`.
title: AGENTS.md attributes pre-commit hook to Husky (wrong tool)
code_does: .githooks/pre-commit is a plain bash script (no husky). It runs `scripts/check-lockfile-drift.sh` and `scripts/check-engine-purity.sh`. It explicitly does NOT run format or clippy lints (hook comments say those are reserved for CI to avoid slowing developer flow).
documentation_says: AGENTS.md line 49: '**Pre-commit**: husky runs format + cheap lints + lockfile-drift check on touched files.'

description: Beyond the wrong tool attribution (vis-001), AGENTS.md also misrepresents what the pre-commit hook actually checks. It claims the hook runs 'format + cheap lints + lockfile-drift check', but the hook only runs two gates: lockfile-drift and engine-purity. Formatting and linting are CI-only; the hook's own comment explicitly explains why they were excluded.
title: AGENTS.md pre-commit gate list is wrong (format/lints not run locally)
code_does: .githooks/pre-commit runs only (1) `scripts/check-lockfile-drift.sh` and (2) `scripts/check-engine-purity.sh`. The hook comment reads: 'Other heavier gates (cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --frozen, the mock-drift gate, the baseline-cap gate, the full e2e suite) are reserved for CI.'
documentation_says: AGENTS.md: 'husky runs format + cheap lints + lockfile-drift check on touched files'

description: VISION.md's tech stack table lists the build layer as 'Trunk / cargo-leptos'. cargo-leptos is a completely separate tool from Trunk (it is an alternative Leptos build system, not a complement). The project uses only Trunk: Trunk.toml exists at src/Trunk.toml, tauri.conf.json's beforeDevCommand is 'trunk serve --port 1420', beforeBuildCommand is 'trunk build --release', and there is no cargo-leptos configuration or invocation anywhere in the repository.
title: VISION.md tech stack lists cargo-leptos as the build tool alongside Trunk
code_does: Only Trunk is used. src/Trunk.toml configures the build. tauri.conf.json `beforeDevCommand` = `trunk serve --port 1420`, `beforeBuildCommand` = `trunk build --release`. No cargo-leptos config file or CLI invocation exists.
documentation_says: VISION.md tech stack table: '| Build | Trunk / cargo-leptos |'

description: The README's 'Common commands' table lists `(cd src && wasm-pack test --node)` as the way to run wasm-bindgen tests. wasm-pack is not installed in the development environment, is not referenced in any Cargo.toml, Trunk.toml, or CI configuration. The CI pipeline (.agentex.yml) runs `cargo test --workspace --frozen` for host-side tests with no wasm-pack invocation. The project uses wasm-bindgen-test (the crate, listed as a dev-dependency in src/Cargo.toml), but the runner is not wasm-pack.
title: README documents wasm-pack as the wasm-bindgen-test runner, but wasm-pack is not used
code_does: wasm-pack is not installed. CI .agentex.yml test step only runs `cargo test --workspace --frozen` — no wasm-pack step. The dev dependency in src/Cargo.toml is `wasm-bindgen-test = "0.3"` which can be invoked via `cargo test --target wasm32-unknown-unknown`, not wasm-pack.
documentation_says: README.md commands table: '`(cd src && wasm-pack test --node)` | Run wasm-bindgen-tests (DOM-bound logic)'
